sentences.full_sentence: Man detained in Óbidos for hunting near houses
A 50-year-old man was detained by the National Republican Guard (GNR), on Wednesday, for hunting near houses, that force of authority announced today.

“Following a complaint, and after investigative measures, the military intercepted the suspect hunting in land close to houses, in a protective strip of less than 250 meters”, said the GNR statement, which mobilized the Óbidos Territorial Post and the Caldas da Rainha Environmental Protection Center.
extracted: Caldas da Rainha Environmental Protection Center

sentences.full_sentence: The man was accused of the crime of hunting on unauthorized land and the report of the situation was forwarded to the Caldas da Rainha Court.
extracted: the crime of hunting on unauthorized land

sentences.full_sentence: The arrest also resulted in the seizure of a hunting rifle, two 12-gauge cartridges and various materials and accessories related to hunting.
